pdf.intro: Thank you for your interest in our services. We are pleased to submit the following quotation for your review.
pdf.amountsInAed: All prices are in UAE dirhams (AED).
pdf.validity: This quotation is valid until {{date}}. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.
pdf.contact: Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.

statement.openingRow: Owed at the start of the period

pdfFile.shareFailed: The PDF couldn't be shared. Download it instead.

list.intro: Prepare a quotation, send it as a PDF on your letterhead, and record the customer's answer.
list.intro_projects: Price a job room by room, send it as a PDF on your letterhead, and record the customer's answer.
list.noMatchesHint: Try another number or name, or show all quotations.

empty.title: No quotations yet
empty.body: Make your first quotation: pick the customer, add what you'll sell, and send it as a PDF.
empty.body_projects: Make your first quotation: pick the customer, add the work room by room with pictures, and send it as a PDF.
empty.viewer: Quotations your team prepares show here.

editor.pageIntro: Nothing is sent until you send it. You can save a draft and come back.
editor.pageIntro_projects: Add the work room by room, with a picture for each item. Nothing is sent until you send it.
editor.customerLocked: A revision keeps its customer. To quote another customer, copy the quotation instead.
editor.customerRefHint: Their enquiry or LPO number, if they gave one.
editor.validUntilHint: Leave "Valid until" empty to use your usual number of days (Settings → Documents).
editor.linesHint: Type a name: your products and services show as you type. Or type anything, it stays on this quotation.
editor.linesHint_projects: Type a name: your services and work items show as you type. Or type any item, it stays on this quotation.
editor.typedOnly: You can't see your products and services, so type each line.
editor.title: Item
editor.fromList_projects: From your services and work items
editor.saveAsItem: Save as a product or service
editor.detailsPlaceholder:
Material: oak veneer
Fittings: soft-close hinges
editor.notePlaceholder: e.g. Marble price to be added after the customer picks it
editor.pictureInvalid: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture of up to 10 MB.
editor.pictureHint: Every picture prints the same size. Adjust chooses the part that shows.

crop.title: Adjust the picture
crop.description: Drag the picture and zoom to choose what shows in its frame. Every picture prints in this same frame.
crop.how: Drag to move it. Pinch, scroll or use the slider to zoom.
crop.preview: As it prints on the quotation
crop.cantOpen: This picture can't be opened here. Pick it again.
crop.savedNote: This picture is saved in its frame, so what was cut off can't come back. Zoom in and drag to choose a part of it, or pick it again to choose another part.

areas.addLineNoArea: Add a line without an area
areas.dialogHint: Its name is printed down the side of its lines on the PDF.
areas.lineToNone: Line {{number}} is now without an area.

errors.exists: There is already an area with this name.

editor.addDiscount: Add a discount on the whole quotation
editor.roundHint: Type the total you want, with VAT (for example 15,000). BizCost works out the change before VAT.
editor.roundStale: The lines changed after you rounded the total, so the rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundCarried: This total was rounded on the revision before, and its rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundCarriedCopy: This total was rounded on the quotation it was copied from, and its rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundStaleHint: The total stays rounded: check the totals
editor.stagesHint: When the customer pays, and how much of the total each time.
editor.wordsHint: Printed above and below the lines. Leave a box empty to use the usual words.
editor.introPlaceholder: Thank you for your interest in our services. We are pleased to submit the following quotation for your review.
editor.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Prices include supply and installation.
editor.termsPlaceholderNew: Leave empty to use your usual terms (Settings → Documents).
editor.notesPlaceholder: Anything else the customer should know
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this quotation. Open it again to see the latest version.

errors.validBefore: "Valid until" can't be before the quotation's date.
errors.title: Type what this line is.
errors.productGone: This product or service was removed. Type the line again.
errors.due: Say when this payment is due.
errors.discountOverLine: The discount is more than this line.
errors.discountOver100: A discount can't be more than 100%.
errors.discountOverLines: The discount is more than the lines.
errors.discountMixed: Some prices include VAT and some don't. Give the discount as a %.
errors.roundUnreachable: This total can't be reached. Try a number closer to the total.
errors.stagesNot100: The payments must add up to 100%.

editor.roundHintNoVat: Type the total you want (for example 15,000). BizCost spreads the difference over the lines.

view.title: Quotation {{number}}
view.draftNote: This is a draft: the customer hasn't seen it. Send it when it's ready.
view.expiredNote: This quotation was valid until {{date}}. The customer can still accept it.
view.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it belongs to a branch you don't work in.

pdf.title: Quotation PDF
pdf.draftNote: A draft's PDF says "Draft" on every page.
pdf.sendNote: Download the PDF, or share it with WhatsApp or a mail app.

confirm.sendBody: Once sent, this revision can't be changed. To change it later, make a new revision.
confirm.sendNote: Then download the PDF or share it with the customer.
confirm.acceptBody: Record that the customer accepted this quotation.
confirm.acceptNote: You can then make an order from it.
confirm.signedHint: A PDF or a photo of the quotation the customer signed.
confirm.declineBody: Record that the customer declined this quotation. You can still revise it or copy it later.
confirm.reviseBody: Revision {{revision}} stays as it was sent. The new one opens as a draft for you to change.
confirm.reviseNote: Once you send the new revision, it replaces this one.
confirm.reviseAccepted: For extra work: the customer accepts the new revision again.
confirm.revised: Revision {{revision}} of {{number}} is ready to change.
confirm.copyBody: A new quotation with its own number, dated today, with the same lines. Pick its customer.
confirm.orderBody: An order for {{amount}} waits for delivery, with the same customer and lines.
confirm.orderNote: Nothing counts as a sale until the order is delivered.
confirm.discardBody: The draft and its pictures are removed. Its number isn't used again.

files.title: Files
files.hint: The customer's signed copy, drawings or photos.
files.afterSave: Save the quotation first, then attach files.

list.intro: Your invoices: drafts to finish, and issued invoices with what they're paid and what they still owe.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, LPO or customer
list.noMatchesHint: Try another number, LPO or name, or show all invoices.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.body: Make your first invoice: from scratch, or from an accepted quotation, an order or a sale you recorded.
empty.viewer: Invoices your team prepares show here.

deposits.title: Deposits without a tax invoice
deposits.hint: A deposit needs its tax invoice within 14 days of the day it was paid.
deposits.needsLook: Deposits waiting for their tax invoice
deposits.needsLookHint: A deposit needs its tax invoice within 14 days of the day it was paid.

start.title: Bill something you already have
start.intro: Or fill in the invoice below from scratch.
start.quotationHint: All of it, a stage or a deposit
start.quotationPick: Choose the quotation to invoice. One that became an order is invoiced from its order.
start.orderHint: All of it, a deposit or the rest
start.saleHint: A One sale with its customer
start.salePick: Choose the sale to invoice. It needs its customer.
start.saleNone: No sale with a customer to invoice.
start.saleBody: The invoice bills {{sale}} as it was recorded: {{amount}}.
start.saleNote: The sale already counts in your sales, so issuing the invoice adds nothing to them. What the customer owes moves to the invoice.
start.saleRefused: This sale can't be invoiced: it needs its customer and no refund, and it may have its invoice already.

bill.title: Invoice {{source}}
bill.body: Choose what this invoice bills. It's saved as a draft: you check it, then issue it.
bill.partHint: A percentage or an amount, such as a deposit
bill.deposit: It's a deposit, paid before the work
bill.depositHint: The final invoice takes the deposit off before VAT, so VAT is charged once.
bill.depositOnly: After a deposit invoice, another part is a deposit too; the final invoice bills the rest.
bill.restFinalHint: The whole work, less the deposits already invoiced
bill.made: A draft invoice of {{source}} is ready to check.
bill.refused: This can't be billed this way. Check what was invoiced already, or choose the rest.

errors.over_left: That's more than is left to invoice.

bill.stageNext: Bill the stages in their order: {{name}} first.

bills.final: The final invoice of {{source}}: the work, less its deposits.
bills.sale: Bills a sale you recorded, as it was.

counted.question: Is this sale already in your recorded sales (Today's sales, an import or your POS)?
counted.why: So each sale counts once in your sales and profit.
counted.yesHint: The invoice won't count it again.
counted.no: No, count it with this invoice
counted.noHint: Its sale counts on the date of supply.
counted.required: Answer this to issue the invoice.
counted.beforeIssue: Before you issue it, you'll be asked whether this sale is already in your recorded sales.

editor.pageIntro: Fill it in and save it as a draft. Issue it from its page: then it takes its number.
editor.pageIntroTax: Fill it in and save it as a draft. Issue it from its page: then it takes its number and becomes your tax invoice.
editor.customerHintTax: For a customer registered for VAT, their TRN and address print on the tax invoice.
editor.lpoHint: Their purchase order number, if they gave one.
editor.supplyDateHint: When the work was done or the goods delivered. Leave it empty when it's the day you issue the invoice.
editor.dueDateHint: Optional. Unpaid after it, the invoice shows as overdue.
editor.linesHint: Type a name: your products and services show as you type. Or type anything, it stays on this invoice.
editor.linesHint_projects: Type a name: your services and work items show as you type. Or type any item, it stays on this invoice.
editor.addDiscount: Add a discount on the whole invoice
editor.sourcedLines: The lines come from what it bills. To bill something else, discard this draft and start again.
editor.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for your business
editor.created: Draft invoice saved. Check it, then issue it.
editor.conflict: Someone changed this draft meanwhile. Open it again to see the latest version.
editor.late: A tax invoice is due within 14 days of the supply. This one was due by {{date}}: issue it as soon as you can.

errors.dueBefore: The due date can't be before the date of supply.

view.title: {{kind}} {{number}}
view.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it's from a branch you don't work in.
view.draftNote: A draft has no number yet and counts nowhere. Issue it to give it its number.
view.creditedAll: Credit notes took all of it back ({{amount}}).
view.creditedPart: Credit notes took back {{amount}} of it.

counts.moved: Its sale counts on {{date}}, the first open day (your books were closed).
counts.order: This sale counts when order {{number}} is delivered.
counts.sale: The sale it bills already counts.
counts.deposit: A deposit: the final invoice counts the whole work.
counts.elsewhere: It's already in your recorded sales, so it isn't counted again.
counts.orderDelivered: Its sale counted when order {{number}} was delivered on {{date}}.

missing.title: Before you can issue it
missing.customer_address: The customer's address (they're registered for VAT)
missing.currency_aed: Your currency must be AED for a tax invoice
missing.fixBusiness: Add it in your business profile

warnings.ibr_143_ae: Your address has no street, city or emirate. E-invoices will need all three.
warnings.ibr_144_ae: The customer's address has no street, city or emirate. E-invoices will need all three.
warnings.late: The supply was more than 14 days ago: a tax invoice was due by {{date}}. Issue it as soon as you can.

firstTax.title: Before your first tax invoice
firstTax.body: A tax invoice prints your TRN and your business address. Add them once in your business profile; every invoice after uses them.

issue.title: Issue {{kind}}?
issue.body: It takes the next invoice number and today's date. After that it can't be changed or deleted.
issue.note: To fix it, you'll issue a credit note.
issue.missing: It can't be issued yet: add what is missing, then issue it again.
issue.conflict: What this draft bills has changed (its quotation or order changed, or another invoice of it was issued). Discard it and make it again.
issue.booksClosed: Your books are closed up to today, so nothing can be issued today. Issue it tomorrow, or once the books are open again in Settings.

pdf.title: Invoice PDF
pdf.issuedTitle: {{number}} is issued: download or share it
pdf.draftNote: A draft's PDF says "Draft" on every page and has no number.
pdf.sendNote: Download the PDF, or share it with WhatsApp or a mail app.

discard.title: Discard this draft?
discard.body: It has no number yet, so no number is lost.

copy.title: Copy to a new quotation?
copy.body: A new draft quotation for {{name}} with this invoice's lines (deposits taken off are left out).

files.title: Files
files.hint: The customer's LPO, a signed delivery note or anything else for this invoice.

credit.title: {{kind}} for invoice {{number}}
credit.description: It takes back part or all of the invoice. The invoice itself never changes.

reasons.tax_treatment_changed: The VAT treatment of the supply changed

credit.reasonTextHint: Printed on the credit note, e.g. 4 m² of glass not fitted.
credit.eventDateHint: The day of the return, the cancellation or the new price.
credit.late: A tax credit note is due within 14 days of what happened: by {{date}}. Issue it as soon as you can.
credit.noneLeft: Nothing is left to credit on this invoice.

counted.question: Is this refund already in your recorded sales (Today's sales, an import or your POS)?
counted.why: The invoice's sale was already recorded, so its refund may be too.
counted.yesHint: The credit note won't lower your sales again.
counted.no: No, take it off with this credit note
counted.noHint: It lowers your sales on the day it's issued.

credit.issueBody: It takes back {{amount}} of {{number}}, with the next credit note number and today's date.
credit.issueNote: After that it can't be changed or deleted.
credit.keptDraft: Kept as a draft. Issue it from the invoice's page.
credit.discardBody: It has no number yet; the invoice stays as it is.
credit.pdfIssuedTitle: {{number}} is issued: download or share it
credit.conflict: Someone changed this credit note meanwhile. Open the invoice again.

errors.reasonText: Explain why, in a few words.
errors.lines: Enter what it takes back of at least one line.

statement.title: Statement for {{name}}
statement.intro: What was invoiced or delivered, credited and paid over a period, and what is owed.
statement.periodError: Choose a period of up to two years, ending today at the latest.
statement.pdfNote: Download the statement, or share it with WhatsApp or a mail app.
statement.intro_plain: What was delivered or sold, refunded and paid over a period, and what is owed.

links.paidOnInvoices: It has an invoice: payments are recorded on the invoice now.
links.saleOfInvoiceNote: This is invoice {{number}}'s sale. To correct it, issue a credit note on the invoice.
links.saleOfCreditNoteNote: This is a credit note's sale. It isn't changed here.
links.invoicedSaleNote: Invoice {{number}} bills this sale. To correct it, issue a credit note on the invoice.
links.paidOnOrderToo: It has invoices: what is paid on the order counts toward them first, then toward what is not invoiced yet.
